mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flash_order (id, user_id, product_id, quantity, pay_amount_cents, status, pay_channel, pay_txn_id, idempotency_key, create_time, pay_time, fulfill_time, close_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{payAmountCents}, #{status}, #{payChannel}, #{payTxnId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createTime}, #{payTime}, #{fulfillTime}, #{closeTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, product_id, quantity, pay_amount_cents, status, pay_channel, pay_txn_id, idempotency_key, create_time, pay_time, fulfill_time, close_time, update_time FROM flash_order WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update:

status = #{to}, update_time = NOW(),
pay_time = #{changeTime},
fulfill_time = #{changeTime},
close_time = #{changeTime},
WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = #{from}
